---
title: "Machine Learning in Real-World Drug Studies"
subtitle: "ACPE 2026 Educational Session, Track C"
---

**Friday 30 October 2026** · Part of the [Asian Conference on
Pharmacoepidemiology (ACPE) 2026 educational
sessions](https://www.asianpharmacoepi.org/educational-sessions/).

This track introduces foundational concepts, principles, and applications of
natural language processing (NLP) and large language models (LLMs) in
real-world pharmacoepidemiologic studies. Participants will gain practical
exposure to basic coding workflows and machine learning–driven disease
phenotyping strategies, while learning to critically evaluate epidemiologic
biases in NLP/LLM-enhanced analyses.
